predictions.headline: Islanders moneyline against a Kings side stuck on a .286 points percentage
predictions.text: New York Islanders to win on the moneyline. The Islanders are 5-3-1 (.611) with 27 goals scored and only 20 conceded, and they beat Anaheim 3-2 on 20 October, S. Holmstrom scoring the game-winner and I. Sorokin the winning goalie. Los Angeles are 1-4-2 (.286) with 17 goals in seven games and a minus-ten goal difference, and this is the middle game of three on the road in five nights. Their 5-2 win in Washington on 20 October, with E. Gustafsson scoring the winner and D. Kuemper in goal, is the only bright spot in the sample. Back the Islanders on the moneyline at our price.
facts: NHL.com standings, 21 Oct: NYI 5-3-1, .611 P%, 27 GF / 20 GA; LAK 1-4-2, .286 P%, 17 GF / 27 GA.
NHL.com schedule: Los Angeles play at Washington on 20 Oct, at the Islanders on 22 Oct and at New Jersey on 24 Oct.
NHL.com schedule, 20 Oct: Islanders 3-2 Anaheim (S. Holmstrom GWG, I. Sorokin W); Los Angeles 5-2 at Washington (E. Gustafsson GWG, D. Kuemper W).
predictions.match: Los Angeles Kings @ New York Islanders

predictions.headline: Devils moneyline as Los Angeles close a three-game road trip
predictions.text: New Jersey Devils to win on the moneyline. The Devils are 5-4-0 with a .556 points percentage and a 29-30 goal split after beating Colorado 4-3 on 20 October, when J. Boqvist scored the game-winning goal and J. Allen was the winning goalie. Los Angeles are 1-4-2 for a .286 points percentage, have scored only 17 goals in seven games and were out-scored 27-17. They won 5-2 in Washington on 20 October behind E. Gustafsson's winner and D. Kuemper in net, but that is their only win in seven games and this is the last of three road games in five nights. Back New Jersey at our originated price, with the -1.5 puck line as the secondary angle.
facts: NHL.com standings, 21 Oct: NJD 5-4-0, .556 P%, 29 GF / 30 GA; LAK 1-4-2, .286 P%, 17 GF / 27 GA.
NHL.com schedule, 20 Oct: New Jersey 4-3 Colorado (J. Boqvist GWG, J. Allen W); Los Angeles 5-2 at Washington (E. Gustafsson GWG, D. Kuemper W).
predictions.match: Los Angeles Kings @ New Jersey Devils

predictions.headline: Oilers moneyline: the league's best points percentage meets a Leafs side shipping goals
predictions.text: Edmonton Oilers to win on the moneyline. Edmonton own the best points percentage in the league at .833 (7-1-1) with 41 goals scored and 27 conceded, and they beat Minnesota 4-3 in overtime on 20 October through E. Bouchard's game-winner with D. Levi in goal. Toronto are 5-4-2 (.545) with 38 goals scored and 35 conceded in 11 games, and they won 6-2 in Columbus on 20 October in which A. Matthews scored the winner and A. Stolarz was the winning goalie. Take Edmonton on the moneyline and consider the -1.5 puck line.
facts: NHL.com standings, 21 Oct: EDM 7-1-1, .833 P%, 41 GF / 27 GA; TOR 5-4-2, .545 P%, 38 GF / 35 GA.
NHL.com schedule, 20 Oct: Edmonton 4-3 Minnesota OT (E. Bouchard GWG, D. Levi W); Toronto 6-2 at Columbus (A. Matthews GWG, A. Stolarz W).

predictions.headline: Bruins moneyline against a San Jose side without a regulation win
predictions.text: Boston Bruins to win on the moneyline. Boston are 7-2-1 for a .750 points percentage, have scored 36 and allowed 22, and they are 7-2-1 across their last ten, most recently a 3-2 overtime loss in Dallas on 20 October in which M. Rantanen scored the winner. San Jose are 5-4-1 but have zero regulation wins in ten games and a minus-eight goal difference (27 for, 35 against), even though they won 4-3 in overtime in Montréal on 20 October through M. Celebrini's winner and A. Nedeljkovic in net. The Bruins at home are the selection, with the -1.5 puck line as an alternative.
facts: NHL.com standings, 21 Oct: BOS 7-2-1, .750 P%, 36 GF / 22 GA, RW 6; SJS 5-4-1, .550 P%, 27 GF / 35 GA, RW 0.
NHL.com schedule, 20 Oct: Dallas 3-2 Boston OT (M. Rantanen GWG, J. Oettinger W); San Jose 4-3 Montréal OT (M. Celebrini GWG, A. Nedeljkovic W).

predictions.headline: Hurricanes moneyline: a .773 side against a .500 Blues team
predictions.text: Carolina Hurricanes to win on the moneyline. Carolina are 8-2-1 (.773), have scored 42 goals, second only to Vegas in these standings, and conceded 27, and they won 6-3 in Vancouver on 20 October with N. Deslauriers scoring the winner and P. Kochetkov in goal. St. Louis are 4-4-1 (.500) with a level 29-29 goal record and won only 2-1 at home to Winnipeg on 20 October, P. Broberg scoring the game-winner and J. Hofer the winning goalie. Back Carolina on the moneyline at our price, and the -1.5 puck line for the bigger return.
facts: NHL.com standings, 21 Oct: CAR 8-2-1, .773 P%, 42 GF / 27 GA; STL 4-4-1, .500 P%, 29 GF / 29 GA.
NHL.com schedule, 20 Oct: Carolina 6-3 at Vancouver (N. Deslauriers GWG, P. Kochetkov W); St. Louis 2-1 Winnipeg (P. Broberg GWG, J. Hofer W).

flagged.item: Several parallel fixture datasets coexist and disagree
flagged.detail: The mechanical audit at the bottom of this page counts the rows in each earlier build and lists the same fixtures that carry different picks. Reconciling or retiring those tables is an owner decision; this desk does not delete another session's files.

flagged.item: Start times for the ten Northern Ireland Open ties are blank
flagged.detail: The WST match list renders clock times in the reader's locale and does not publish a venue-local start time in the page text. Dates are verified; times are not, so they are blank rather than converted.

flagged.item: NHL arenas, MLB ballparks and EHF halls are blank
flagged.detail: The NHL.com schedule, MLB.com postseason and EHF match-list pages used for the rows do not print the venue. Venues are left blank; filling them would need each game page opened individually.

flagged.item: One game per club: no NBA row can reach High confidence
flagged.detail: At capture only six clubs had played a 2026-27 game. The model shrinks toward .500, so every NBA pick is Low or Medium and no NBA prediction is published. This is a data-volume limit, not a judgement about the games.

The PDC schedule is fully verified (16 ties, venue, session windows), but the PDC rankings page is behind a cookie wall in this environment, so no ranking or form input was captured and every darts line is 50/50. Per-match throw times are not published by the PDC; only the session window is shown.

flagged.item: Handball lines are prior-only and the timezone is unstated
flagged.detail: The EHF match list prints 18:45 and 20:45 but does not state the timezone, so the time is reproduced verbatim with that warning. No EHF strength table was captured, so the line is a 50/50 prior plus the declared home edge.

flagged.item: Eleven constants are declared assumptions, not fitted values
flagged.detail: Weights, home edge, puck-line and total dispersions, the shrinkage prior and the confidence thresholds are stated on the methodology page. None is calibrated against closing prices, because no market prices are read.

flagged.item: Player names appear as initial plus surname
flagged.detail: The NHL.com schedule page publishes the winning goalie and game-winning scorer as initial plus surname (for example M. Celebrini). Predictions reproduce that form rather than expanding first names.
